  • Technology Roadmap: Define the MFT platform roadmap, including version upgrades, migration strategies (e.g., to cloud/SaaS offerings), new product adoption (e.g., Flow Manager), and deprecation planning.
  • Capacity Planning: Perform capacity planning, performance tuning, and scaling assessments for the MFT platform to support increasing file volumes and partner counts.

Security and Compliance Governance

  • Security Design: Collaborate with Enterprise Security teams to enforce security best practices, including PKI management, TLS/SSL certificate handling, firewall rules, and encryption standards (PGP, FIPS 140-2).
  • Policy Enforcement: Define, document, and govern MFT policies and standards to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements (e.g., PCI-DSS, HIPAA, GDPR, SOX).
  • Audit and Visibility: Design the monitoring and logging infrastructure, typically involving Axway Sentinel or integration with enterprise SIEM/monitoring tools, to provide comprehensive end-to-end visibility and a clear audit trail for all file transfers.

Technical Leadership and Consulting

  • Solution Design Review: Review and approve technical designs for new file transfer workflows, partner onboarding.
  • SME Consulting: Act as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for all Axway products, providing guidance to delivery teams, operations staff, and project managers.
  • Automation Strategy: Champion and drive the implementation of DevOps principles and Infrastructure-as-Code (e.g., Terraform, Ansible) to automate platform provisioning, configuration, and flow deployment.
  • Troubleshooting: Serve as the final escalation point for complex, persistent performance and stability issues that cannot be resolved by L2/L3 support teams.

Job Summary

This Control-M Administrator job description outlines the key responsibilities, qualifications, and skills required for a professional to manage and maintain an organization's Control-M environment.

A Control-M Administrator is responsible for the daily operation, maintenance, and support of the BMC Control-M Workload Automation suite. This includes ensuring the smooth scheduling and execution of batch jobs, proactive monitoring, troubleshooting issues, and implementing changes and enhancements to the Control-M environment. The ideal candidate will possess a strong understanding of IT operations, scheduling concepts, and excellent problem-solving skills.

Key Responsibilities

  • Administration and Configuration:
    • Install, configure, and maintain Control-M components (e.g., Control-M/Enterprise Manager, Control-M/Server, Control-M/Agents, Application Integrator, etc.).
    • Manage and administer Control-M security, including user accounts, roles, and permissions.
    • Perform regular health checks and performance tuning of the Control-M environment.
    • Implement and manage Control-M High Availability and Disaster Recovery solutions.
  • Job Scheduling and Management:
    • Design, develop, and implement complex batch schedules and workflows using Control-M.
    • Monitor job execution, identify failures, and troubleshoot issues to ensure timely completion of critical processes.
    • Modify, test, and promote Control-M definitions (jobs, folders, calendars, etc.) across different environments (dev, test, prod).
    • Provide support to application teams for their scheduling requirements.
  • Troubleshooting and Support:
    • Act as a subject matter expert for Control-M-related issues, providing 2nd and 3rd-level support.
    • Diagnose and resolve issues related to job failures, Control-M component malfunctions, and connectivity problems.
    • Collaborate with other IT teams (e.g., OS, network, database, application teams) to resolve complex issues.
    • Participate in on-call rotation for off-hours support as required.
  • Maintenance and Optimization:
    • Apply patches, upgrades, and fixes to Control-M components.
    • Develop and maintain documentation for Control-M configurations, procedures, and best practices.
    • Identify opportunities for automation and optimization within the Control-M environment.
    • Perform regular clean-up and archiving of Control-M logs and historical data.
  • Reporting and Compliance:
    • Generate reports on job statistics, schedules, and system performance.
    • Ensure compliance with internal policies and external regulations related to job scheduling and data processing.

Qualifications

  • Education:
    • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience:
    • Minimum of 3-5 years of hands-on experience as a Control-M Administrator in a production environment.
    • Experience with Control-M version 9.x or higher is preferred.
    • Proven experience in designing, implementing, and supporting complex Control-M solutions.

Required Skills

  • Technical Skills:
    • In-depth knowledge of BMC Control-M Workload Automation suite, including Control-M/Enterprise Manager, Control-M/Server, Control-M/Agents (Windows, Unix/Linux), Control-M/Application Integrator, and other add-ons.
    • Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., Shell scripting, PowerShell, Python) for automation and customization.
    • Strong understanding of operating systems (Windows, various Unix/Linux distributions).
    • Familiarity with database concepts (e.g., Oracle, SQL Server) as they relate to Control-M.
    • Knowledge of network protocols and troubleshooting.
  • Soft Skills:
    • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
    • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse teams.
    • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
    • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
    • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.

Desired (Plus) Skills

  • Experience with other scheduling tools or automation platforms.
  • Knowledge of ITIL principles and practices.
  • Experience in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Familiarity with DevOps and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Relevant Control-M certifications.

title: Shift Lead (Aligned Locally with Engineers)
description:
The Shift Lead acts as the escalation point and operational supervisor for a team of Network Operations Engineers during their assigned shift. This role ensures incidents are resolved within SLA, coordinates with cross-functional teams, and maintains operational discipline across the NOC.

Key Responsibilities:

· Provide technical and operational guidance to L1/L2 engineers.

· Act as the first escalation point for critical incidents.

· Oversee ticket triage, assignment, and closure for the shift.

· Ensure adherence to SOPs and escalation procedures.

· Coordinate with Team Leader, WiFi Specialist, and site technicians as needed.

· Maintain shift-level reporting and incident summaries.

· Mentor and coach team members to build skill depth.

Qualifications:

· 5+ years of experience in NOC or network engineering roles.

· Proven leadership skills in a 24x7 operational environment.

· Strong knowledge of routing, switching, and WiFi technologies.

· Familiarity with incident, problem, and change management processes.

· Industry certifications such as CCNP, JNCIP, or equivalent preferred.

title: Network Team Leader
description:
Role Summary: The Team Leader oversees the global NOC delivery team, ensuring 24x7 operational excellence, SLA adherence, and stakeholder communication. Based in the US (West Coast), this role serves as the ultimate escalation point, manages vendor/client governance, and drives continuous improvement initiatives across the NOC.

Key Responsibilities:

· Lead and manage a global team of Network Engineers, Shift Leads, and WiFi Specialists.

· Serve as the final escalation point for critical P1/P2 incidents.

· Coordinate with client stakeholders, telcos, and OEM vendors.

· Ensure SLA compliance, incident trend analysis, and proactive risk mitigation.

· Oversee staffing plans, shift coverage, and resource allocation.

· Deliver weekly/monthly/quarterly performance reports to Meta.

· Champion continuous improvement, automation, and SOP enhancements.

· Provide mentoring and development pathways for team members.

Qualifications:

· 10+ years of experience in network operations or IT infrastructure management.

· Demonstrated leadership in managing large distributed teams.

· Deep expertise in enterprise network technologies (Cisco, Juniper, Arista, Aruba).

· Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

· Advanced certifications such as CCIE, JNCIE, or equivalent preferred.

· Experience in service delivery governance for Fortune 100 clients is a plus.

title: Network Operations Engineer (L1/L2)
description:
Role Summary:
The Network Operations Engineer (L1/L2) is responsible for proactive monitoring, incident response, troubleshooting, and operational support of Client global network infrastructure. This role ensures the availability, reliability, and performance of routers, switches, firewalls, wireless controllers, and related devices across data centers, offices, and distribution centers.
Key Responsibilities:
•     Monitor network alerts and alarms, triaging issues as they arise.
•     Perform SOP-based troubleshooting and incident resolution.
•     Escalate unresolved or complex issues to Shift Leads or higher-level engineers.
•     Track, update, and close tickets in accordance with SLAs.
•     Assist with configuration updates, patches, and vulnerability remediation.
•     Support scheduled maintenance activities under supervision.
•     Maintain accurate documentation of incidents and configurations.
Qualifications:
•     Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, or related field (or equivalent experience).
•     2–5 years of experience in network operations or IT support.
•     Hands-on experience with Cisco, Juniper, Arista, and/or Aruba technologies.
•     Familiarity with monitoring tools, ITSM platforms, and ticketing systems.
•     Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
•     CCNA or equivalent certification preferred.

title: Wifi network engineer specialist
description:
The WiFi Network Engineer Specialist (L3) provides expert-level support for complex wireless issues, advanced troubleshooting, and network design. This role ensures Client large-scale WiFi infrastructure performs optimally and securely, while mentoring junior engineers and contributing to knowledge management.
Key Responsibilities:
•     Lead advanced troubleshooting of wireless controllers, Client, and related infrastructure.
•     Provide root cause analysis (RCA) and drive permanent issue resolution.
•     Design and implement wireless solutions to improve performance and coverage.
•     Assist during major P1/P2 incidents as the WiFi subject matter expert.
•     Ensure compliance with security policies and remediate wireless vulnerabilities.
•     Partner with Shift Leads and Team Leader for escalation support.
•     Contribute to SOP creation, knowledge transfer, and training of L1/L2 staff.
Qualifications:
•     7+ years of experience in wireless networking engineering.
•     Expert-level knowledge of Cisco and Aruba/HPE wireless solutions.
•     Proven experience designing and deploying enterprise WiFi at scale.
•     Strong background in RF analysis, wireless security, and optimization.
•     Certifications such as CWNP, CCNP Wireless, or Aruba Certified ClearPass Professional.
